concepts.source_evidence: 4 ANOTHER PEEK BEYOND THE POINT 4.1 A Quick Recap of Decimals Recall that decimals are the natural extension of the Indian place value 1 1 1 system to represent decimal fractions ( , , , and so on) and 10 100 1000 their sums.

concepts.source_evidence: For example, 27.53 refers to a quantity that has: • 2 Tens • 7 Units (Ones) • 5 Tenths • 3 Hundredths We have already learned how to multiply and divide fractions.
